Game Overview

Outher Space is a arcade game built around pilot your spaceship through an asteroid field, blasting rocks for currency to unlock stylish ship costumes. Balance ammo carefully, collect falling tokens, and upgrade your gear for endless fun in the boundless cosmos. Enjoy the thrills of cosmic adventure and strategic shooting in every direction.

How to Play

Getting started in Outher Space doesn't take long to learn. Pilot your spaceship through an asteroid field, blasting rocks for currency to unlock stylish ship costumes.
